# A sample library with fmGraph boards

For fmIDE's tests (group 55, Try in fmGraph): one pack holding a canvas template "Sales" and a
system template "Plan", each carrying an fmGraph board, and a canvas template "Plain" without
one. Markup and quotes in the pack's title, Sales's name and its board's name must show as
plain text. Its records were written by
`node tools/check-pack.js --library … --write-records --account ann-example --account-id 1001 --date 2026-10-03`.
